End-to-end verification of Phase 1:

1. src/web/templates/ no longer exists — templates sourced from themes/default/.
2. zetl serve (no --theme) renders identically to before (no visual regression).
3. zetl serve --theme minimal renders with the minimal theme (no CDN, system fonts).
4. zetl build --theme minimal produces valid static site.
5. zetl theme list shows both bundled themes with correct metadata.
6. Create .zetl/themes/custom/ with a page.html override. zetl serve --theme custom uses disk template for page.html, falls back to bundled default for others (three-tier).
7. Create .zetl/themes/minimal/ with a page.html override. zetl serve --theme minimal uses disk page.html (Tier 1), bundled minimal base.html (Tier 2). zetl theme list shows 'installed (shadows bundled)'.
8. --verbose shows resolution tier per template.
9. Binary size increase from bundled themes is < 100 KB (NFR-014-002).
10. cargo test passes.
